siblings.en: Heat's likely. The number's still settling.
siblings.af: Hitte is waarskynlik. Die getal settle nog.
siblings.st: Mocheso mohlomong o teng. Palo e sa ntsane e lula.

items.en: Could turn stormy. Keep one eye on the sky.
items.text: Kan stormagtig raak. Hou een oog op die lug.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Could turn stormy. Keep one eye on the sky.
siblings.af: Kan stormagtig raak. Hou een oog op die lug.
siblings.st: Ho kana ha fetoha sefefo. Lula u shebile leholimo ka hloko.

items.en: Storm's possible. The braai might need a rain check.
items.text: Storm is moontlik. Die braai mag 'n reëndatum nodig kry.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Storm's possible. The braai might need a rain check.
siblings.af: Storm is moontlik. Die braai mag 'n reëndatum nodig kry.
siblings.zu: Isiphepho siyenzeka. Ukosa kungase kudinge usuku olunye.
siblings.xh: Isaqhwithi siyenzeka. Ukugrila kungafuna olunye usuku.
siblings.st: Sefefo se ka etsahala. Braai e ka hloka letsatsi le leng.

items.en: Weather might get serious. Stay loosely on alert.
items.text: Weer kan ernstig raak. Bes om peraat te bly.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Weather might get serious. Stay loosely on alert.
siblings.af: Weer kan ernstig raak. Bes om peraat te bly.
siblings.st: Boemo ba leholimo bo ka ba boima. Lula u hlokometse.

items.en: Probably brewing something. Stay close to a roof.
items.text: Waarskynlik iets aan die brou. Bly naby 'n dak.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Probably brewing something. Stay close to a roof.
siblings.af: Waarskynlik iets aan die brou. Bly naby 'n dak.
siblings.zu: Cishe kukhona okuphekwayo. Hlala eduze nophahla.
siblings.xh: Mhlawumbi kukho into ephekwayo. Hlala kufutshane nophahla.
siblings.st: Mohlomong ho na le ntho e phehoang. Lula u le haufi le marulelo.

items.en: Storm on the cards, not yet confirmed. Stay sharp.
items.text: Storm op die kaarte, nog nie bevestig nie. Bly skerp.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Storm on the cards, not yet confirmed. Stay sharp.
siblings.af: Storm op die kaarte, nog nie bevestig nie. Bly skerp.
siblings.st: Sefefo se monyetleng, ha se e-s'o netefatsoe. Lula u falimehile.

items.en: Sky's looking moody. Could escalate.
items.text: Lug lyk nukkerig. Kan eskaleer.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Sky's looking moody. Could escalate.
siblings.af: Lug lyk nukkerig. Kan eskaleer.
siblings.st: Leholimo le bonahala le halefile. Ho ka eketseha.

items.en: Probably a clear night. The stars haven't confirmed.
items.text: Waarskynlik 'n helder nag. Die sterre het nog nie bevestig nie.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Probably a clear night. The stars haven't confirmed.
siblings.af: Waarskynlik 'n helder nag. Die sterre het nog nie bevestig nie.
siblings.st: Mohlomong bosiu bo hlakileng. Linaleli ha li e-s'o netefatse.

items.en: Calm night, most likely. The sky reserves the right to change.
items.text: Kalm nag, heel waarskynlik. Die lug hou voor om te verander.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Calm night, most likely. The sky reserves the right to change.
siblings.af: Kalm nag, heel waarskynlik. Die lug hou voor om te verander.
siblings.st: Bosiu bo khutsitseng, mohlomong. Leholimo le ka fetoha.

items.en: Looks settled out there. Roughly.
items.text: Lyk rustig daar buite. Min of meer.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Looks settled out there. Roughly.
siblings.af: Lyk rustig daar buite. Min of meer.
siblings.st: Ho bonahala ho khutsitse. Hoo e ka bang.

items.en: Probably quiet skies. We're fairly sure.
items.text: Waarskynlik stil lug. Ons is redelik seker.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Probably quiet skies. We're fairly sure.
siblings.af: Waarskynlik stil lug. Ons is redelik seker.
siblings.xh: Mhlawumbi isibhakabhaka esithe cwaka. Siqinisekile mhlawumbi.
siblings.st: Mohlomong maholimo a khutsitseng. Re na le bonnete mohlomong.

items.en: Clear-ish night. Don't hold us to the stars.
items.text: Helder-ish nag. Moenie ons by die sterre hou nie.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Clear-ish night. Don't hold us to the stars.
siblings.af: Helder-ish nag. Moenie ons by die sterre hou nie.
siblings.zu: Ubusuku bucacile kancane. Ungathathi lesi sibikezelo sezulu ngokweqiniso kakhulu.
siblings.xh: Ubusuku obucacileyo kancinci. Musa ukusibamba ngeenkwenkwezi
siblings.st: Bosiu bo hlakile hanyane. U se ke ua re tshepisa ka linaleli.

items.en: Night looks calm. Models permitting.
items.text: Nag lyk kalM. As die modelle dit reg het.
items.label: good

siblings.zu: Ubusuku bubukeka buzolile. Uma amamodeli evuma.
siblings.xh: Ubusuku bubonakala buzolile. Ukuba iimodeli ziyavuma.
siblings.st: Bosiu bo bonahala bo khutsitse. Haeba limodele li lumela.

items.en: Probably Weather checks five weather sources every time you open the app. We average them so you get a more honest forecast — no single source guessing wrong about whether it'll rain.
items.text: I-Probably Weather ihlola imithombo emihlanu yesimo sezulu ngaso sonke isikhathi uvula uhlelo lokusebenza. Sihlanganisa amalinganiso ukuze uthole isibikezelo esiqotho — akukho mthombo owodwa oqagela kabi ngokuthi imvula iyona noma cha.
items.label: good

siblings.en: Probably Weather checks five weather sources every time you open the app. We average them so you get a more honest forecast — no single source guessing wrong about whether it'll rain.
siblings.af: Probably Weather kyk na vyf weersbronne elke keer wat jy die app oopmaak. Ons stel hulle gemiddelde saam sodat jy 'n meer eerlike voorspelling kry — geen enkele bron wat verkeerd raai oor of dit gaan reën nie.
siblings.zu: I-Probably Weather ihlola imithombo emihlanu yesimo sezulu ngaso sonke isikhathi uvula uhlelo lokusebenza. Sihlanganisa amalinganiso ukuze uthole isibikezelo esiqotho — akukho mthombo owodwa oqagela kabi ngokuthi imvula iyona noma cha.
siblings.xh: I-Probably Weather ijonga imithombo emihlanu yemozulu ngalo lonke ixesha uvula i-app. Sidibanisa imilinganiselo ukuze ufumane isiprofeto esinyanisekileyo — akukho mthombo omnye oqikelela ngokungafanelekanga ngokuba kuza kuna na okanye hayi.
siblings.st: Probably Weather e sheba mehlodi e mehlano ea boemo ba leholimo nako e nngwe le e nngwe ha u bula app. Re kopanya likarolelano hore u fumane ponelopele e tšepahalang — ha ho mohlodi o le mong o akhang hampe ka hore ho tla na pula kapa che.
